title: Cursor Agents read - write - act across Google Workspace
dependency_review: Inspected the imports and runtime reads of all three cursorworkspace generators. gen/cursorworkspace_gen.py (YouTube split) and gen/cursorworkspace_cutout_gen.py (TikTok cutout) both import the sealed shared module gen/cursorworkspace_scene.py plus pipeline/captions.py, pipeline/pointing_cues.py and formats/cutout/lib/{cutout_core,cutout_depthfield}; gen/cursorworkspace_whiteboard.py deliberately does NOT import the scene module (its header says so) and instead imports pipeline/captions.py with formats/whiteboard/lib/{whiteboard_build,whiteboard_fix6_core}. Both lib directories are shipped whole because their modules import their siblings and carry their own JSON constants (cutout6_pillw.json, envelope.json, _capwidths_whiteboard.json). gen/cursorworkspace_cutout_gen.py additionally reads plans/cursorworkspace_plan.json at import time to assert the depth-lane roster, so the plan is a runtime dependency and not only documentation. Logos: STAGE_FILES resolves cursor.png, google-workspace.png, gmail-color.png, google-calendar.png, google-drive.svg and google-sheets.png from the central assets library; DEPTH_FILES adds claudecode-color.png, codex-color.png, copilot-color.png, notion-color.png, slack-color.png and airtable-color.png for the cutout only. Every one of these is already staged inside each project's assets/logos, so the project folders carry them and no library path needs to be copied separately. Audio and plate media likewise live inside the project assets (music/bed.mp3, sfx/{click,pop,whoosh}.mp3, v/*). projects/cursorworkspace_whiteboard/assets is a SYMLINK to shorts_run17/stage/cursorworkspace_whiteboard and must be materialized by the copier, not copied as a link; the split and cutout project assets are real directories. Cut inputs shipped whole in cuts/cursorworkspace: master.mp4, audio.m4a, face_full_hd.mp4, face_bottom_hd.mp4, edl.json and transcript_tight.json (the tight transcript is the word-timing source every cue table asserts against). The full ASR transcript for the raw recording is intake/transcripts/2026-09-04 14-17-15.json and the raw recording itself is /Users/migle/Movies/2026-09-04 14-17-15.mp4 (670 MB, present). Matting: the plate/selection/measure/ship JSONs and the selection mask are shipped; the large derived mattes (matte_cursorworkspace_v5_*.webm, plate_wide_25.mp4, alpha_v1.mkv, matting-cache) are excluded because the exact mattes used are already inside the project assets/v folders. External runtime requirements: Python via ~/Documents/Workspace/.venv (Pillow, cairosvg for the google-drive.svg rasterization, numpy for the cutout envelope), ffmpeg/ffprobe for the envelope and media probes, and the HyperFrames CLI (pinned 0.7.107, installed globally) to render the index.html projects; no CDN script is loaded by the compositions. No secrets, no unrelated recordings and no whole-workspace copies are included.
title_note: The Notion idea title is 'Cursor Agents read/write/act across Google Workspace'; the slashes are illegal in a package folder name, so they are replaced by ' - ' exactly as earlier packages did ('Comp AI: open-source agentic CRM, plug in Codex - Claude Code', 'SuperGrok Plus: new $100 - mo tier'). No words are changed.
